tools.name: how_to_hire_in_the_uae
tools.description: How hiring in the UAE works through Moha, an Employer of Record, for a company with no UAE entity: when it fits, the information needed about the hire and the company, the employee's documents, the steps, the timeline and the prices. No account needed.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Monthly and upfront cost of employing one person in the UAE through Moha, an Employer of Record: salary split, employer costs, government fees, insurance, our fee and VAT, plus how long the visa takes. No account needed.

tools.name: prepare_hire
tools.description: Prepares one hire in the UAE without an account. Returns the quote and a link: the person opens it, checks the details and creates their Moha account. Moha checks the company before the hire goes ahead. Nothing is charged or sent to the employee before that.

tools.name: prepare_account
tools.description: Prepares a Moha account without signing in: company profile, the person setting it up, one to ten hires and colleagues to invite. Returns the quotes and one link to confirm. Moha checks the company first; hires go ahead and colleagues are invited only once approved.

tools.name: check_prepared_hire
tools.description: Whether the person opened the link from prepare_hire or prepare_account and created their account yet.
